name: @colibri-kit/ui
rules: Markup contract: data-ui="name" roots, data-ui-part="part" children; state in data-state / aria-* / hidden.
Never style by JS; theme only through --ui-* tokens in themes/colibri.css (or your own CSS).
Events are ui:* CustomEvents that bubble; cancelable ones can be preventDefault()-ed.
Forms: wrap each control in data-ui=field (label, control, description, error).
Option sets: use toggle-group / radio-group; menus: dropdown-menu; overlays: dialog/sheet/popover.
Compose blocks from components; do not invent new data-ui names for layouts (use classes).
Application entries use data-application-component and the documented optional application controllers, not invented data-ui registrations. Check support and adapters per entry.

import { DropdownMenu, Part } from "@colibri-kit/ui/react";

export function Demo() {
  return (
    <DropdownMenu>
      <Part name="trigger" as="button">Actions</Part>
      <Part name="content">
        <Part name="label">Article</Part>
        <Part name="item" as="button">
          Edit
          <kbd>⌘E</kbd>
        </Part>
        <Part name="item" as="button">Duplicate</Part>
        <Part name="item" as="button" disabled>Archive</Part>
        <Part name="separator" as="hr" />
        <Part name="item" as="button" data-type="checkbox" aria-checked="true">Published</Part>
        <Part name="radio-group">
          <Part name="item" as="button" value="ka" data-type="radio" aria-checked="true">Georgian</Part>
          <Part name="item" as="button" value="en" data-type="radio">English</Part>
        </Part>
        <Part name="sub">
          <Part name="sub-trigger" as="button">Share</Part>
          <Part name="sub-content" hidden>
            <Part name="item" as="button">Facebook</Part>
            <Part name="item" as="button">Email</Part>
          </Part>
        </Part>
        <Part name="separator" as="hr" />
        <Part name="item" as="button" data-variant="destructive">Delete</Part>
      </Part>
    </DropdownMenu>
  );
}

items.name: sidebar-01
items.title: Sidebar · Simple, grouped
items.description: A simple sidebar with navigation grouped by section.
items.whenToUse: App shells, docs sites and dashboards. Copy the markup and swap in your links.
items.accessibility: Composed from Sidebar (data-state expanded/collapsed, toggles get aria-expanded/aria-controls; Ctrl/Cmd+B in apps, off here so blocks don't fight), Collapsible, Dropdown menu, Popover, Tooltip, Calendar and File tree. Below the breakpoint the sidebar becomes an off-canvas sheet (Esc / outside click closes). The current page link has aria-current=page.

items.name: login-01
items.title: Login · Simple login card
items.description: A simple centered login card: email, password, remember me, Google, plus magic-link, forgot-password and code-verification steps.
items.whenToUse: Copy into your login/registration page; wire ui:submit to your Spring endpoint (or submit the form normally).
items.accessibility: One <form data-ui=auth-form novalidate> with several views (password, magic-link, forgot, sent, otp, done); only the visible view is validated/submitted and its first field gets focus. Errors use Field (aria-invalid + aria-describedby, role=alert); a polite status line reports the result. Provider buttons emit ui:provider; submit emits cancelable ui:submit {view, values}. Toggle-password, Checkbox, Pin input, Separator and Card are the same components as elsewhere.
items.html:
Login to your account

Enter your email below to login to your account

Don't have an account?Sign up

Login with a magic link

Reset your password

We'll email you a reset link.

Check your email

Check your inbox for a link. It expires in 15 minutes.

Enter verification code

We sent a 6-digit code to your email.

Didn't receive it?

You're in 🎉

This is where the app would redirect.

[#import "/colibri/freemarker/ui.ftl" as ui]
[@ui.authForm id="login-01" action="/login" view="password"]
  [@ui.authView name="password" next="otp" title="Login to your account"]
    [@ui.authProviders list=["google"] verb="Login with" /]
    [@ui.authField label="Email" name="email" type="email" /]
    [@ui.authField label="Password" name="password" type="password" /]
    <button data-ui="button" type="submit">Continue</button>
  [/@ui.authView]
  [@ui.authView name="otp" next="done" title="Enter verification code"][@ui.pinInput name="otp" /][/@ui.authView]
[/@ui.authForm]

Login to your account

Enter your email below to login to your account

Don't have an account?Sign up

Login with a magic link

Reset your password

We'll email you a reset link.

Check your email

Check your inbox for a link. It expires in 15 minutes.

Enter verification code

We sent a 6-digit code to your email.

Didn't receive it?

You're in 🎉

This is where the app would redirect.

items.name: login-03
items.title: Login · Muted background
items.description: A login card on a muted page with Apple and Google first, then email.
items.whenToUse: Copy into your login/registration page; wire ui:submit to your Spring endpoint (or submit the form normally).
items.accessibility: One <form data-ui=auth-form novalidate> with several views (password, magic-link, forgot, sent, otp, done); only the visible view is validated/submitted and its first field gets focus. Errors use Field (aria-invalid + aria-describedby, role=alert); a polite status line reports the result. Provider buttons emit ui:provider; submit emits cancelable ui:submit {view, values}. Toggle-password, Checkbox, Pin input, Separator and Card are the same components as elsewhere.

Welcome back

Or continue with

items.freemarker:
[#ftl output_format="HTML"]
[#import "/colibri/freemarker/ui.ftl" as ui]
[@ui.authForm id="login-03" action="/login" view="password"]
  [@ui.authView name="password" next="otp" title="Login to your account"]
    [@ui.authProviders list=["google"] verb="Login with" /]
    [@ui.authField label="Email" name="email" type="email" /]
    [@ui.authField label="Password" name="password" type="password" /]
    <button data-ui="button" type="submit">Continue</button>
  [/@ui.authView]
  [@ui.authView name="otp" next="done" title="Enter verification code"][@ui.pinInput name="otp" /][/@ui.authView]
[/@ui.authForm]

items.name: css-start
items.title: Getting started
items.description: One stylesheet: reset, tokens, base styles, a few layout primitives and opt-in components, all in cascade layers.
items.whenToUse: Plain sites, FreeMarker pages and anywhere you want good defaults without a utility framework.
items.accessibility: Install: link packages/colibri-css/dist/colibri.css (or @colibri/css). Optional: dist/colibri-ui-bridge.css after themes/colibri.css makes Colibri UI components read Colibri CSS tokens.
items.html:
Drag the corner to resize the preview

Why Colibri CSS

Modern CSS, not class soup.One 15 KB stylesheet with no build step: finished defaults for semantic HTML, OKLCH tokens driven by one--c-hue, fluid type, built-in dark mode, and a handful of layout primitives. It's the styling half of Colibri: Colibri UI handles behaviour, Colibri CSS handles the look.

  • Layers:your CSS always wins, no!important.
  • Tokens:re-brand globally or per section by changing one value.
  • Primitives, not utilities: .stack .grid .split .cluster… tuned with custom properties, responsive with no breakpoints.
  • Platform-native:container queries,:has(), nesting,light-dark(),clamp().
  • Bridge:Colibri UI components share the same tokens.

Read the full pitch, comparison table and setup on the library page:examples/colibri-css.html· packagepackages/colibri-css· READMEpackages/colibri-css/README.md
